title: Zero, First i Second Conditional – sprawdź się
intro: 10 zadań: tłumaczenie całych zdań, dopasowanie połówek, luki, wybór formy i szukanie błędu. Skróty (I'd, won't) i przecinki nie mają znaczenia.

items.source: Gdybym miał więcej czasu, nauczyłbym się grać na gitarze.
accepted: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
If I had more time, I would learn how to play the guitar.
I would learn to play the guitar if I had more time.
I would learn how to play the guitar if I had more time.
If I had more time, I would learn to play guitar.
I would learn to play guitar if I had more time.
If I had more time, I would learn how to play guitar.
I would learn how to play guitar if I had more time.
items.explanation: Hipoteza o teraźniejszości: If + Past Simple, would + bezokolicznik. Skrót I'd też jest poprawny.

items.source: Jeśli jutro będzie padać, zostaniemy w domu.
accepted: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
We will stay at home if it rains tomorrow.
We will stay home if it rains tomorrow.
If it is raining tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it is raining tomorrow, we will stay home.
items.hint: first conditional – po if bez will
items.trap: Po if nie stawiamy will, choć po polsku mówimy „będzie padać”: If it rains, nie „If it will rain”.
items.explanation: Realna przyszłość: If + Present Simple, will + bezokolicznik.

accepted: If I were you, I would apologise to her.
If I were you, I would apologize to her.
If I was you, I would apologise to her.
I would apologise to her if I were you.
If I were you, I would say sorry to her.
If I was you, I would say sorry to her.
I would say sorry to her if I were you.
I would apologise to her if I was you.
items.explanation: Rada w formie second conditional: If I were you, I would… (was też się spotyka, were jest staranniejsze).

items.source: Kiedy podgrzewasz lód, on się topi.
accepted: If you heat ice, it melts.
When you heat ice, it melts.
Ice melts if you heat it.
Ice melts when you heat it.
If ice is heated, it melts.
When ice is heated, it melts.
items.explanation: Fakt, który jest zawsze prawdziwy: zero conditional, czyli Present Simple w obu częściach.

items.source: Nie zdasz egzaminu, jeśli nie będziesz się uczyć.
accepted: You won't pass the exam if you don't study.
You won't pass the exam unless you study.
If you don't study, you won't pass the exam.
Unless you study, you won't pass the exam.
You won't pass your exam if you don't study.
You won't pass your exam unless you study.
If you don't study, you won't pass your exam.
Unless you study, you won't pass your exam.
items.trap: Unless zawiera już przeczenie: unless you study, nie „unless you don't study”.
items.explanation: First conditional z przeczeniem: if you don't study = unless you study; w części głównej won't.

items.source: Co byś zrobił, gdybyś wygrał milion euro?
accepted: What would you do if you won a million euros?
What would you do if you won a million euro?
What would you do if you won one million euros?
If you won a million euros, what would you do?
If you won a million euro, what would you do?
If you won one million euros, what would you do?
items.explanation: Pytanie o hipotezę: What would you do if you + Past Simple?

pairs: I would travel around the world.
items.explanation: Zero conditional – fakt zawsze prawdziwy; first – realna przyszłość (will); second – hipoteza (would).

items.text: If you {{1}} (mix) red and blue, you {{2}} (get) purple.

accepted: mix
get
will get
'll get

items.explanation: Stała zależność (jak na lekcji plastyki): zero conditional, czyli Present Simple w obu częściach. Will get też jest poprawne.

items.prompt: We'll miss the bus ___ we leave right now.
optionNotes: If daje zdanie bez sensu: spóźnimy się, jeśli wyjdziemy teraz.
Because podaje przyczynę, a tu potrzebny warunek.
So wprowadza skutek, a nie warunek.
items.explanation: Unless = if … not: spóźnimy się, jeśli nie wyjdziemy teraz.
Po if w first conditional stoi Present Simple: If it rains on Sunday, we'll cancel the trip.
